_about: Claude's literal back-translation of Codex's translations (each model back-translates the other's work, never its own). Literal on purpose: says what the text says, does not repair it.

es-419.L02: There is no checkpoint yet. Saving happens from the first SAFE POINT.
es-419.L03: HOLD E: keep turning, %d of %d, or leave the relay to WOLF.
es-419.L04:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay near RELEASE TANK.
es-419.L05: The bypass lever is stiff. The coolant hisses as it comes out of the relay housing and an alarm starts to howl.
es-419.L06:
Nobody gives an activation order.
WOLF wakes up by himself.
es-419.L07: WOLF: That purge erases the program's original records. When they disappear, his/her/your word will be the only record.
es-419.L08: WOLF: At the relay you would have sent me in blind. I'm not going to step into its sights. Work out when to drop from RELEASE TANK; it crosses the mark on every pass.
es-419.L09: SENTRY  WOLF refused to lure it, so {name} worked out when to drop without help.
es-419.L11: The relay could release coolant. You decide.
es-419.L12:
The door bursts. WOLF backs off
to wait for %s's signal.

de.L02: No checkpoint yet. Saving happens from the first SAFEGUARD POINT.
de.L03: HOLD E: Crank on, %d of %d, or leave the relay to WOLF.
de.L04:
The guard saw %s in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
de.L05: The bypass lever is jammed. Coolant hisses out of the relay housing, and an alarm starts to howl.
de.L06:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.
de.L07: WOLF: This deletion destroys the original program logs. Once they are gone, only his word is left as evidence.
de.L08: WOLF: At the relay you would have sent me in blind. I won't run into its sights. Time the drop at the TANK RELEASE; it crosses the marking on every round.
de.L09: GUARD  WOLF didn't want to lure it, so {name} timed the drop without help.
de.L11: The relay could vent coolant. You decide.
de.L12:

and waits for the signal from %s.

ja.L02: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts from the first SAFE POINT.
ja.L03: Hold E: turn the crank. %d/%d. You may also leave the relay to WOLF.
ja.L04:
%s was found by the sentry in a place with no cover.
Let's stay by the TANK DROP.
ja.L05: The bypass handle is stiff. Coolant leaks from the relay housing with a noise, and an alarm starts to ring.
ja.L06:
Nobody issues an activation order.
WOLF wakes up by himself.
ja.L07: WOLF: That purge makes the original program logs disappear. Once they disappear, the record becomes only that man's words.
ja.L08: WOLF: At the relay, you almost sent me in without knowing the situation. I won't enter the sentry's sights. Judge the moment of the drop at TANK DROP. It passes the mark on every patrol.
ja.L09: SENTRY  WOLF refused to lure it out, and {name} judged the moment of the drop alone.
ja.L11: Coolant might burst out of the relay. I leave the judgment to you.
ja.L12:
The door blows away. WOLF backs off
and waits for %s's signal.
